thread:
lee: Quick sync  planning to lift the SDK pin for hosted-api from 3.4.0 -> 4.0.0 in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. This enables auth header v2 + multiplexing perf. Need ops and mobile sign-off. Any blockers?
ana: mobile team still on 3.x; saw auth failures last week with header rename.
rachel: agree with gating. Also mention rollback triggers and add TLS check note.
lee: rollback criteria: deploybot will reapply sdk_pin=3.4.0 if 5xx_rate>1% sustained for 10m OR 401_rate>2x baseline for 5m. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> manual approval -> 100%.
deploybot: Scheduled. Gates: "mobile/compat==ok" and "sdk/pr/4201==merged". Will annotate each stage.
tyler: telemetry: eu-central saw auth spike during a header test. Recommend a 20m preflight at 01:40 running integration smoke on shadow routes.
lee: added 20m preflight at 01:40. If any integration test fails, abort.
rachel: release notes draft ready: include migration snippet and mobile workaround.
infra-bot: load-shed rule: if p95>2s AND cpu>85% in canary, hold and page.
lee: update: PR 4201 merged 01:12 UTC. mobile sign-off pending.
nana: mobile hotfix ETA 01:25; asking for hold until then.
lee: decision: gate unpin on mobile hotfix. If signed off by 01:25, proceed; otherwise keep at 25% canary and abort full rollout.
deploybot: Gate set. Will not execute final bump until "mobile/compat==ok".
infra-bot: monitoring hooks created for 02:00-03:00 UTC. Alerting on thresholds.
lee: mobile hotfix landed at 01:23 UTC :white_check_mark: mobile/compat==ok. Proceeding with canary at 02:00.
deploybot: Canary started 02:02 -> 5% clients. Metrics: 5xx flat, 401s +8% but within threshold. Advancing to 25%.
tyler: holding before 100%; mobile team reports intermittent 401s in some batched flows. Recommend waiting 30m.
lee: hold final bump. Keep 25% for 30m, then reassess. No rollback.
rachel: release notes updated: called out held rollout and troubleshooting steps.
lee: closing thread; followups in #release-notes and mobile channel. Thanks all.
